sources.snippet: The images were decoded with the full-frame VAE and stored as PNGs. Training re-encodes those images, so the targets differ from directly cached terminal teacher latents. The L40S run used extracted copies of the published shards. The SimpleTuner example qwen_image-2.1-assistant-lora-offline.peft-lora reads the same data through Webshart.

sources.title: Qwen Image - SimpleTuner
sources.snippet: Qwen Image 2.1 uses Ollin's texture-fixed VAE by default for validation and other VAE decoding. Only the decoder was fine-tuned; the encoder is unchanged, so existing 2.1 training latents remain compatible. The VAE revision is pinned independently of the base model.
